Thank you for your quick response and for clarifying that the "FailsafeMode_active" error is appearing in the backend.
As we mentioned in our previous email, your SCB router currently appears offline from our monitoring system. This offline status prevents us from accessing its diagnostic data to investigate the "FailsafeMode_active" error.

Once the station is back online, we will be able to access its diagnostic data and proceed with troubleshooting.
We appreciate your assistance in getting the charger reconnected.
Best regards,
Ivan
